answer: A sybil tax stops bulk fake identities. Each new agent pays a non-refundable 20-unit tax into a vault; it is never returned, so capital cannot be recycled. Like the fable of one honest shopkeeper, an honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards. A forger making 1000 identities pays 1000 x 20 = 20000 units plus 2000 in fees, more than any gain from flooding votes. A saffron trader pays per stall, so splitting cannot multiply influence.
